shots.content: Inside a meeting room, a rectangular conference table stands between a presentation screen and a glass door, with windows along one side; a clear walkway runs opposite the window. A man in a purple shirt sits in the door-side window seat and asks about the consultation, a man in a red shirt sits in the screen-side window seat, a woman in a green shirt sits in the screen-side walkway seat, and a man in an orange shirt sits in the door-side walkway seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the glass door end, looking along the conference table toward the presentation screen, with both window-side seats and both walkway-side seats and the presentation screen in frame.

shots.content: A man in a purple shirt and a man in a red shirt exchange seats, and he asks him to assist with the case.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the walkway side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: A man in a purple shirt agrees to help review the inquiry.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot directly above the conference table.
